team.label: La Pitaya team
team.hint: Fills name, character, description and goal with a CIMA role. You review and spawn.

locales.agentLocaleDesc: The language La Pitaya agents write their messages and reports in. Independent of the interface language. Commands, code, logs and test output are never translated.
locales.notificationLocaleDesc: The language of notices and, later, of Alicia's summaries. Independent of the interface language.

governance.title: GOVERNANCE APPROVALS
governance.approveHint: Approve allows ONE execution of this exact call. The agent must retry it.

governance_blocked.title: Blocked by CIMA
governance_blocked.message: The action was blocked by CIMA ({{rule}}). {{explanation}}

governance_supervised.title: Supervised action
governance_supervised.message: {{agent}} ran a medium-risk action under supervision. {{explanation}}

approval_granted.title: Approval granted
approval_granted.message: You approved the action from {{agent}}. It will run once.

approval_denied.title: Approval rejected
approval_denied.message: You rejected the action from {{agent}}. It will not run.

workflow_completed.title: Work accepted
workflow_completed.message: Task {{task}} has a DECISION PASS recorded by the runtime.

intent_forwarded.title: Sent to El Inge
intent_forwarded.message: Your request reached El Inge as a proposal; nothing runs until you confirm.

intent_governed.title: Action governed by CIMA
intent_governed.message: CIMA evaluated your action: risk {{risk}}, decision {{decision}}. {{explanation}}

intent_blocked.title: Request blocked
intent_blocked.message: Your request was not sent: CIMA blocked it ({{rule}}). {{explanation}}

request_proposed.title: Proposal waiting for your confirmation
request_proposed.message: El Inge received your request as a proposal. {{explanation}}

request_confirmed.title: Proposal confirmed
request_confirmed.message: You confirmed the proposal. Every action still goes through CIMA; high-risk ones need your separate approval.

error.title: Error
error.message: Something went wrong. See the technical detail.

explain.HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: This action needs your approval because it is classified as {{riskLabel}}.
explain.SUPERVISED: It was allowed under supervision and recorded in the ledger.
explain.APPROVED: It ran once with your approval.
explain.HUMAN_APPROVED: You approved it; that allows one run of that exact call.
explain.HUMAN_REJECTED: You rejected it; it will not run.
explain.DENY: La Pitaya could not authorize this action, so it did not run.
explain.DECISION_GATE: The task cannot be marked done without a DECISION PASS recorded by the runtime.
explain.EVIDENCE_FIRST: The result has no evidence the harness observed.
explain.BUILDER_NOT_AUDITOR: Whoever built the change cannot pass its own tests or audit.
explain.AUDITOR_MODIFIED_CODE: The auditor modified files after BUILD; an auditor never changes what it audits.
explain.TRANSITION: Earlier CIMA phases are missing, so this step cannot be accepted.
explain.DECISION_AUTHORITY: Only El Inge or the human can accept the work.
explain.MALFORMED: The CIMA report is not in the required format.
explain.ALLOW: It is low risk: allowed automatically, and authorized again when it runs.
explain.NOT_AUTHORIZED: Alicia has no authority to approve or to issue a DECISION; that belongs to you and El Inge.
explain.INTENT_INVALID: The request was incomplete or malformed, so it was not processed.
explain.INTENT_TARGET: Alicia can only address requests to El Inge, not to other agents or to tools.
explain.INTENT_MISMATCH: What you asked for carries more risk than the proposed action, so CIMA did not send it.
explain.DELIVERY_FAILED: The request could not be delivered to El Inge.
explain.BOUNDARY_UNAVAILABLE: The request boundary did not answer; nothing was done.
explain.REQUEST_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: Nothing runs until you confirm the proposal; meanwhile only reading, analysis and replies are allowed.
explain.REQUEST_SCOPE_EXCEEDED: The action goes beyond what you confirmed in the proposal, so it did not run.
explain.NOT_CONFIRMABLE: The proposal can no longer be confirmed (already confirmed, cancelled or closed).
explain.TAMPERED: The confirmation does not match the proposal, so it was rejected.
explain.STALE_PROPOSAL: The proposal is no longer valid; it has to be requested again.
explain.WRONG_CONTEXT: The confirmation does not belong to this proposal.
explain.UNKNOWN: Rule {{rule}} stopped it. See the technical detail.

evidence.verified: {{verified}}/{{total}} evidence items verified by the harness

reply.task: I'm here. Task {{task}} is at {{phase}} ({{phaseLabel}}); you have {{unread}} unread notices.
reply.idle: I'm here. There is no active task; you have {{unread}} unread notices.

intentTypes.REQUEST: Request: El Inge prepares a proposal and waits for your go-ahead.
intentTypes.ACTION: Action: goes through CIMA (risk, autonomy and authorization) before it runs.

confirmation.title: ALICIA · PROPOSAL CONFIRMATION
confirmation.role: Alicia presents the proposal and receives your decision. The CIMA runtime decides what may execute.
confirmation.loadError: Could not read the proposals from the runtime. Nothing was changed.
confirmation.empty: No REQUEST proposals are waiting for you.
confirmation.pendingBanner: Proposals waiting for your confirmation: {{count}}. Until you decide, nothing on the floor executes.

scopeExplain.LOW: If you confirm, the floor may only inspect (LOW risk). Changes would need a new REQUEST.
scopeExplain.MEDIUM: If you confirm, LOW and MEDIUM risk actions may continue, each one still authorized by CIMA when it runs.

confirmation.meaning: Confirming lets this REQUEST continue to CIMA governance. It does not execute anything by itself.
confirmation.highNote: Confirming the REQUEST is not approving a high-risk action: every HIGH action needs its own approval in Human decisions.
confirmation.ack: I have read the proposal and understand that confirming does not approve HIGH actions.
confirmation.confirmedNote: REQUEST confirmed — this is not an approval. Every action is still evaluated by CIMA, and HIGH actions need your separate approval.
confirmation.highPending: CIMA requires your approval for HIGH actions (HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED): {{count}} pending. Decide them in Human decisions; confirming the REQUEST did not approve them.

state.CONFIRMED: REQUEST confirmed — continues through CIMA governance

errors.LEDGER_UNAVAILABLE: The runtime could not record the decision, so nothing changed.
errors.IPC_ERROR: The runtime did not answer, so nothing changed.

said.confirmed: Confirmed. The request will continue through the governance process.
said.stale: That proposal is no longer valid. Ask again if you still need it.
said.changedElsewhere: That proposal changed elsewhere; I am showing its current state.
said.refused: The runtime refused the confirmation ({{code}}). Nothing was executed.

conversation.label: Message for Alicia
conversation.forwarded: I sent it to El Inge as proposal {{id}}. Review it above: nothing executes until you confirm.
conversation.governed: CIMA evaluated your action: risk {{risk}}, decision {{decision}}.
conversation.failed: I could not deliver your message; nothing was done.

observe.activityHint: Facts recorded by the CIMA runtime. Alicia explains them; she does not decide them.
observe.healthHint: The runtime's own verdict about whether its records can be trusted. Alicia shows it; she cannot repair or change it.

health.CORRUPTED: The governance records are damaged. Governance is closed: nothing is authorized until an operator recovers it.
health.INCONSISTENT: The governance state disagrees with its recorded events. Governance is closed until an operator resolves it.
health.UNAVAILABLE: The runtime cannot verify its governance records right now. Governance is closed.

recovery.RECOVERY_REQUIRED: Recovery by an operator is required. The damaged evidence is kept untouched.
recovery.RECOVERED: An operator recovered the records and the result was verified.

observe.legacyUnverified: Records written before v0.15 are trusted as found; their origin is not proven.
observe.unavailable: The reason cannot be confirmed with the available evidence.
observe.noEvidence: No evidence recorded; nothing is claimed.

labels.humanAction: What do you need to do?

what.INTENT_FORWARDED: The runtime handed it to El Inge.
what.INTENT_GOVERNED: CIMA evaluated the action you asked for.
what.INTENT_BLOCKED: The runtime did not send your request.
what.REQUEST_PROPOSED: Your request became a REQUEST: a proposal ({{proposalId}}).
what.REQUEST_REVALIDATED: The runtime re-validated proposal {{proposalId}} before confirming it.
what.REQUEST_CONFIRMATION_DENIED: The runtime refused a confirmation of {{proposalId}}.
what.REQUEST_SUPERSEDED: Proposal {{proposalId}} was replaced by a newer one.
what.REQUEST_BLOCKED: Proposal {{proposalId}} was blocked by the runtime.
what.REQUEST_SCOPE_EXCEEDED: The action was blocked for going beyond the confirmed scope: {{agent}} tried {{operation}}.
what.HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: CIMA stopped {{operation}} by {{agent}}: it needs HIGH approval.
what.COMPLETION_BLOCKED: The runtime prevented a task from being marked as done.
what.EXECUTION_FAILED: {{operation}} by {{agent}} failed when it ran (recorded by the harness).
what.UNKNOWN_EVENT: The runtime recorded a fact Alicia cannot interpret ({{decision}}).

why.INTENT_RECEIVED: Everything you tell Alicia goes through the runtime first.
why.INTENT_CLASSIFIED: The runtime decides whether it is CONVERSATION, REQUEST or ACTION; Alicia does not.
why.INTENT_FORWARDED: El Inge receives requests as a proposal; nothing runs until you confirm.
why.INTENT_GOVERNED: Every ACTION goes through CIMA (risk, autonomy and authorization).
why.INTENT_COMPLETED: The runtime finished processing the intent.
why.REQUEST_PROPOSED: A REQUEST is only a proposal: the runtime lets nothing on the floor execute until you confirm it.
why.REQUEST_REVALIDATED: Before confirming, the runtime checks that the proposal is still valid.
why.REQUEST_CONFIRMED: Your confirmation lets the work continue; every action still goes through CIMA. It is not a HIGH approval.
why.REQUEST_CANCELLED: A cancelled proposal no longer allows work on the floor.
why.REQUEST_COMPLETED: A closed proposal no longer allows work on the floor.
why.REQUEST_SUPERSEDED: Only the newest proposal for the same task counts.
why.EXECUTION_COMPLETED: The harness observed that exact call run after CIMA authorized it.
why.EXECUTION_FAILED: The harness observed that exact call fail or get interrupted.

next.WAITING_HUMAN_CONFIRMATION: Nothing executes until you confirm or cancel the proposal.
next.WAITING_HUMAN_APPROVAL: Review the approval in Human decisions. Confirming the REQUEST did not approve this HIGH action.
next.CONTINUES_UNDER_CIMA: The work continues; every action is still evaluated by CIMA.
next.MAY_EXECUTE: The call may run; its execution will show once the harness records it.
next.APPROVAL_ON_ATTEMPT: When El Inge attempts that action, CIMA will ask for your HIGH approval of that exact call; without it nothing runs.
next.MAY_RUN_ONCE: The agent may retry that exact call once.
next.EXECUTION_FAILED: The tool did not finish successfully.
next.CLOSED: The proposal is closed; nothing else depends on it.
next.TASK_NOT_COMPLETED: The task stays open until the runtime records a DECISION PASS.
next.SEE_LATER_EVENTS: Later facts exist; see the timeline.
next.NOT_AVAILABLE: There is not enough information to say what comes next.

autonomy.AUTO: AUTO: may continue automatically if CIMA authorizes it.
autonomy.SUPERVISED: SUPERVISED: continues under supervision and is recorded in the ledger.

action.DECIDE_APPROVAL: Approve or reject the HIGH action in Human decisions.

decisions.title: HUMAN DECISIONS
decisions.counts: Pending decisions: {{total}} · REQUESTs to confirm: {{requests}} · HIGH actions to approve: {{high}}
decisions.distinction: Confirming a REQUEST and approving a HIGH action are different decisions: confirming lets the proposal continue within its scope; approving authorizes ONE run of one exact HIGH call. Neither replaces the other.
decisions.unobserved: The runtime's explanation could not be read; without evidence nothing is claimed. Decisions still go through the runtime.
decisions.noHigh: No HIGH actions are waiting for your approval.
decisions.historyTitle: Resolved decisions (per the runtime, read only)

owner.actingAs: You are deciding as {{name}} ({{id}}). The app resolves this identity; this screen cannot change it.
owner.unresolved: Your identity could not be resolved by the app, so decisions from this window are refused.

typeMeaning.REQUEST_CONFIRMATION: You confirm that this proposal may continue within its scope. It is not a HIGH approval.
typeMeaning.HIGH_APPROVAL: You authorize ONE run of this exact HIGH call. It confirms no REQUEST and approves no other action.

highState.APPROVED: Approved by you: allows one run of that exact call
highState.REJECTED: Rejected by you: that call will not run
highState.ALREADY_RESOLVED: It was already resolved; showing the runtime state
highState.ERROR: The runtime did not answer; nothing changed

decisions.relatedRequest: It came up under REQUEST {{proposalId}}. Confirming that REQUEST did not approve this action.
decisions.exactCallNote: The approval is bound to the exact call CIMA stopped; the command is not shown here (sensitive-data boundary).
decisions.ack: I reviewed the operation, the rule and the HIGH risk; I approve one execution of the pending call identified above (its command is not shown here).

errors.ALREADY_RESOLVED: The runtime no longer had this approval pending (resolved elsewhere or unknown).
errors.IPC_ERROR: The runtime did not answer, so nothing changed.

said.approved: Approved. The agent may retry that exact call once; CIMA authorizes it again.
said.rejected: Rejected. That call will not run.
said.alreadyResolved: That approval was already resolved; I am showing the runtime state.
said.failed: I could not deliver your decision to the runtime; nothing changed.
